# TwoRoom V4.2 Compromise KANFIS q

## Final Judgment

V4.2 is a Partial Go as a diagnostic compromise, not a replacement for the main V4 path. The best model is `v42_tau05_topk6_hard_medium_R16` with active_rule_count 5.4896. It has clearer hard-motion rules than V4 and mask-best-rule ablation is much stronger than random, but q_v42+action residual MSE is 0.6258 versus q_v41+action 0.6111 and q_v4+action 0.6641 on all_test. Because it does not clearly improve over V4.1 while staying close to V4, the recommended main line remains V4 full q + V4 group explanation.

## Run Provenance Note

The server checkout reported stale commit `4f42a43`; the scripts were synchronized from the local experiment branch by `scp`. This report commit contains the scripts used for this V4.2 run, including compatibility for V4.2 model files saved with a legacy `.pt.pt` suffix. No LeWM model or training code was modified.

V4.2 trains only an external compromise q layer from h. It does not modify LeWM, does not connect to ARPredictor, and does not use q->h reconstruction, h mimicry, hidden distillation, or image reconstruction.

## Judgment Template

V4.2 is Go only if it is closer to V4 performance than V4.1 while improving active rule count and visual clarity. Otherwise, keep V4 full q as main and V4.1/V4.2 as explanatory baselines.
